summary: set_stats options: aggregate (add vs replace), required data dict, and per_host.
questions: How do I replace a stat instead of adding to it?
How do I keep stats per host?

answer_card.title: set_stats parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `data` (required): dict of stats
- `aggregate` (true): add to existing; false replaces
- `per_host` (false)
